sum: The opening tutorial quest: pick your first Warframe, learn movement and combat, and escape Captain Vor in your Liset.

steps.t: Watch the opening cinematic and choose your starter Warframe: Excalibur, Mag or Volt.
steps.tip: Excalibur is melee-focused, Mag is a crowd-control caster, Volt is fast and deals Electricity damage.

steps.t: Use your first ability to fight off the Grineer soldiers around you.
Follow the tutorial prompts to learn jumping, sliding, wall dashing, bullet jumping and aim gliding.
Pick up one melee weapon (Skana or Bo), one sidearm (Lato or Kunai) and one primary (Braton or Paris) along the way.
steps.tip: You receive the primary you did not pick in your inventory afterwards.

steps.t: Deplete Captain Vor's shields when he confronts you.
Hack the console to free your ship and let Ordis power it up.
Survive until the timer runs out, then board your Liset to escape.

fast: The defense stage only requires you to survive until the timer ends; the ship itself does not need protecting.
Mag's crowd control or Volt's speed make the tutorial fights trivial; Excalibur is the easiest all-rounder.
The opening cinematic can be rewatched later from the Codex, so you can skip it without missing anything.

sum: The follow-up to Awakening that walks you through Earth missions to rebuild your Orbiter's Communications and Foundry and break free of Captain Vor's Ascaris device.

steps.t: Start the quest right after Awakening and restore your Arsenal in the Orbiter.
Run the Spy mission on E Prime, Earth to recover the Communications segment.
steps.tip: Installing it unlocks the Market and matchmaking.

steps.t: Rescue Darvo on Mariana, Earth.
steps.tip: He gives you the Ascaris Negator blueprint.

steps.t: Grab the Foundry segment on Mantle, Earth, then clear the Grineer.
Destroy the three Corpus supply caches on Gaia, Earth to get the Negator materials.
steps.tip: The caches are guaranteed to drop what you need.

steps.t: Build the Ascaris Negator in the Foundry.
Recover the navigation segment from the Galleon on Pacific, Earth.
steps.tip: Destroying the reactor afterwards is optional.

steps.t: Assassinate Captain Vor on Cambria, Earth to finish the quest.

fast: On Pacific, the reactor sabotage is optional; extract right after grabbing the navigation segment to save time.
The Ascaris Negator builds in about 10 seconds with no rush cost, so there is no waiting.
On Mariana a rare extraction tile always spawns with a hidden Kuria; bring Codex Scanners if you want to grab it.
First-time mission rewards are fixed, so just play straight through; replaying earlier steps gives nothing extra.

sum: A short quest where Teshin teaches you how mods, elements and fusion work; it also unlocks Cetus and Nightwave.

other: Cannot be started while the Backroom is set as your base of operations

steps.t: Start The Teacher from the Codex in your Orbiter.
Fight through the Corpus in the Earth forest and reach the Mod Segment.
Duel Teshin with the Thornbak until two of his three health bars are gone.
Equip Stormbringer on the Thornbak in the Arsenal to break the Electricity-weak target drones.
steps.tip: Match the mod's polarity to lower its cost.

steps.t: Add Cryo Rounds to combine Cold and Electricity into Magnetic for the next drones.
Equip Vitality on your Warframe, fight off the Corpus and escape with the Mod Segment within the time limit.
Install the Mod Segment, dissolve the spare Stormbringers into Endo and use it to rank up your equipped Stormbringer.
Board the Corpus ship, rescue and then capture Teshin, and sabotage the reactor to finish.

fast: Follow each Arsenal prompt exactly (equip, dissolve, fuse); the quest will not advance until each one is done.
If you already have Vitality equipped, swap to the unranked copy Teshin gives you so the step registers.
On the final ship, hack the two adjacent terminals and shoot the reactor core straight away to finish the sabotage fast.
rw: Pressure Point, Fury, Serration, Hornet Strike, Heated Charge, Continuity, Equilibrium, Redirection

sum: A solo quest in Fortuna and the Orb Vallis that unlocks the Solaris United syndicate, Fortuna bounties and the K-Drive Launcher.

other: Complete the Junction leading to Venus so you can reach Fortuna

steps.t: Go to Fortuna on Venus and talk to Eudico, then Thursby.
Loot the three Corpus supply caches in the Orb Vallis.
steps.tip: Look for barrel-like containers with smoke rising from them.

steps.t: Shoot down the Corpus spy drone and kill the 20 reinforcements, then return to Fortuna.
Talk to Thursby and The Business, then hack the bunker terminal to steal the hit list.
Investigate the four bodies, then hack the terminal and defend it to free the captured field squad.
steps.tip: Killing Terra Jailers drops a data key that speeds up the hack.

steps.t: Talk to Eudico, defend the excavator to dig up Amarast, and head for the coolant tower.
Talk to Eudico again, detonate the K-bomb outside Fortuna and fight off the Corpus waves.
Talk to Eudico, take the K-Drive past the Profit-Taker Orb, hack and defend the coolant tower, then deliver the Amarast.
Return to Fortuna to finish the quest.

fast: Kill the Terra Jailers during the hostage hack; their data keys make the defense much shorter.
Use the K-Drive and your Archwing (if you have it) to cross the Orb Vallis quickly between objectives.
Bring a Warframe with area damage or crowd control for the excavator and coolant tower defenses.

sum: A short three-mission quest on Mercury that introduces the Infested and rewards Molten Impact and the Heat Sword blueprint.

steps.t: Start Once Awake from the Codex in your Orbiter.
Run the Spy mission on M Prime, Mercury and recover the data.
steps.tip: You only need to reach extraction with at least one data unit.

steps.t: Exterminate the Infested on the Galleon at Terminus, Mercury.
Defend the Cascade Bomb on the power core in the Defense mission on Lares, Mercury.

fast: On M Prime you can extract once you have a single data unit; you do not need all three.
Heat damage works well against the Infested; equip the Molten Impact mod you get after Terminus.
Bring a crowd-control Warframe such as Mag for the Lares defense.

sum: A solo quest on Deimos where you help the Entrati family repair the Heart; it unlocks the Entrati syndicate, Necralisk bounties and the Xaku blueprint.

other: Complete the Earth to Mars Junction

steps.t: Start Heart of Deimos from the Codex and go to the Cambion Drift.
Destroy the two Infested Hives (clear the Infested each one spawns) to enter the Necralisk.
Ask Mother all three questions.
Find Father in the Cambion Drift, then talk to Daughter in the Necralisk.
Collect 10 Fass Residue and catch 3 fish for Daughter.
steps.tip: A Fishing Spear is provided at the site if you do not own one.

steps.t: Clear the Infested outside the Necralisk and talk to Daughter.
Take the Esophage down to the Heart and solve the Requiem Cipher door.
steps.tip: Hit the Reactive Crystals in the order of the symbols, top to bottom; retries are unlimited.

steps.t: Sneak back to the surface past the Necramechs with your disabled Warframe.
Pilot the Voidrig, destroy the three Infested Hives, patch the Heart and defeat the rogue Necramech.
steps.tip: Aim for its shoulder joints, face plate and the blue Void scar on its back.

steps.t: Talk to Grandmother in the Necralisk to finish.

fast: You cannot fail the Voidrig stage because you respawn on death, so play aggressively.
Shoot the rogue Necramech's shoulder joints first to remove its guns and melee.
Fass Residue acts as bait, so fish right where it lands rather than wandering.
After destroying the first two hives the open world is quiet, so break containers for free starter resources.

sum: Build your first Archwing, the Odonata, and fly it in space; this unlocks Archwing missions, the Archwing Launcher and Empyrean.

steps.t: Start The Archwing from the Codex to receive the Odonata blueprint.
Run the Orokin Sabotage on Tessera, Venus to recover the archive.
steps.tip: Reverse the portal, defend the generator, then grab the marked cache in the Void.

steps.t: Run the Excavations on Aphrodite (Venus), Mantle (Earth) and E Gate (Venus) for the Wings, Harness and Systems blueprints.
steps.tip: You can extract after the first excavator finishes on each.

steps.t: Build the three Odonata parts and the Odonata in the Foundry.
Run the Exterminate on Montes, Venus.
Equip your Archwing, destroy the Zeplen nets and fly to extraction away from the Balor Fomorian.

fast: Extract after the first successful excavation on each node; one completion gives the blueprint.
The Odonata parts and the Odonata itself now take about a minute each to build, so farm the resources first and build right away.
On Tessera you can ignore the optional Orokin caches; only the marked one in the Void is needed.

sum: A five-mission quest investigating strange drones that reveals the Lotus's secret and rewards an Exilus Warframe Adapter.

steps.t: Start Natah from the Codex in your Orbiter.
Scan the mysterious drones and the wreckage on Gaia, Earth.
steps.tip: Bring Codex Scanners; you must scan the marked targets or the mission fails.

steps.t: Hack the three Grineer consoles in the Mobile Defense on Cassini, Saturn.
Capture Sergeant Scur on Sycorax, Uranus.
Survive for 10 minutes on Ariel, Uranus.
Defend the bomb for 5 waves on Desdemona, Uranus.
steps.tip: The objective you must protect switches between waves.

fast: Buy Codex Scanners from the Market before starting; if your Oculyst Codex entry is already complete, use a Synthesis Scanner instead.
Bring a survival-friendly Warframe for Ariel's 10 minutes and a fast one for Desdemona, where the defended objective moves each wave.
Sycorax is a straightforward Capture: head to the marked target, down Sergeant Scur and capture him.

sum: A major story quest that reveals the Operator and unlocks Focus, Lua and the Broken War.

other: An Archwing (from The Archwing quest) for the two Uranus missions

steps.t: Start The Second Dream from the Codex (optionally watch its cinematic first).
Hack both data vaults in the Spy mission on Umbriel, Uranus.
steps.tip: Archwing required.

steps.t: Find the Sentient fragment underwater on Cressida, Uranus.
steps.tip: If you take about five minutes, a waypoint is added for you.

steps.t: Follow the Stalker on Neso, Neptune: beat the Sentient, use the Void Key, then destroy the four vials to disable the tower.
On Plato, Lua, hack the console, reactivate the three void compasses and destroy the four Pendula.
Play Grimaldi, Lua solo and carry the person to extraction.
Fill the Somatic Link three times in your Orbiter while the Stalker attacks.
steps.tip: You do not need to defeat the Stalker.

steps.t: Customize your Operator and choose a Focus school to finish.

fast: In the final Orbiter fight, fire the Operator beam in short bursts to destroy the Stalker's energy waves; just fill the Somatic Link, the Stalker cannot be killed.
On Cressida, Alad V gives hints when you are near the fragment, and marks it for you after about five minutes.
Your Focus school choice is permanent as your first school; the dialogue answers only reorder the options.
A tanky Warframe with a defensive ability like Iron Skin helps on Grimaldi, where you cannot use weapons.

sum: A major story quest where you chase Teshin to the Kuva Fortress and gain full Operator Transference; it unlocks Sorties, Kuva missions, The Quills and Vox Solaris.

other: Complete the Pluto Junction on Neptune

steps.t: Start The War Within from the Codex after the Lotus's inbox message.
Chase and capture Teshin's Specter on Zeipel, Lua.
Capture another Teshin Specter on Carpo, Jupiter.
Solo the Archwing mission on Naga, Sedna: disable the security matrix, dodge the scanners and defend the console for 2 minutes.
steps.tip: Once you continue into the Fortress you cannot change gear or leave.

steps.t: Infiltrate Dakata, Kuva Fortress and insert the three Elevator Keys to reach the Queens.
As the Operator, escape the Orbiter and climb the Mountain Pass on Earth.
Cross the Golden Maw bone chambers, unlocking Void Sling, Void Mode and Transference.
steps.tip: Keep moving between safe platforms.

steps.t: Defeat the Kuva Guardians and destroy the nine red braids in the Queens' chamber.
steps.tip: Void Sling through a Guardian to make it vulnerable.

steps.t: Defeat Teshin with your Warframe's melee, then Void Sling the Queen when she lowers her shield.
Return to the Mountain Pass, clear the obstacles with Void Sling and Void Beam, and meet Teshin at the summit.

fast: Bring a strong melee weapon; only melee works for the Warframe in the Queens' chamber.
Void Sling through each Kuva Guardian to knock away its Kesheg, then finish it once it switches to pistols.
In the Fortress you can simply sprint past the scanners instead of sneaking.
Operator deaths add stacking Transference Static, so swap back to your Warframe before your Operator dies.
rw: Access to The Quills, Vox Solaris and Necraloid

sum: Recover and repair six Railjack parts with Cephalon Cy to build your own Railjack.

other: Access to a Dry Dock in your Clan Dojo or a Saturn or Pluto Relay

steps.t: Start Rising Tide from the Codex and build the Railjack Cephalon blueprint.
steps.tip: Needs 5,000 Credits, 15 Mutagen Samples, 15 Detonite Ampules and 15 Fieldron Samples.

steps.t: Install Cephalon Cy at a Dry Dock.
Recover the Fuselage on Ares, Mars by defending the wreck while Cy scans it.
steps.tip: Kill the Interference Drones; the scan stalls while they are alive.

steps.t: Deposit the repair resources at the Dry Dock after each part.
steps.tip: Each repair takes about one to two minutes and cannot be rushed.

steps.t: Recover the Propulsion System on Cervantes, Earth.
Recover the Port Nacelle on Plato, Lua.
Recover the Starboard Nacelle on Tessera, Venus.
Recover the Tail Section on Berehynia, Sedna.
Recover the Engine Cowling on Orias, Europa.
Confirm Cephalon Cy's integration at the Dry Dock to finish.

fast: Farm repair resources first: Plastids, Rubedo, Neural Sensors, Cryotic, an Orokin Cell, Nano Spores, Circuits, Alloy Plate, Polymer Bundle, Ferrite, Detonite Ampules and Salvage.
Kill Interference Drones the moment they appear; scan progress freezes while they live.
Stay inside the defense circle, and bring a crowd-control Warframe for the Sentient waves in later missions.
A fully built Railjack can be bought from the Market for 175 Platinum, which skips the quest entirely.

sum: A horror-themed quest with the Red Veil where you track down Rell's manifestations; it rewards the Harrow blueprint and Iron Wake access.

other: Visit Onkko in Cetus and get the Mote Amp

steps.t: Visit Onkko in Cetus as your Operator and get the Mote Amp, then start the quest from the Codex.
Investigate the derelict Galleon on Pacific, Earth and defend Palladino until the timer runs out.
Meet Palladino at Iron Wake, Earth.
steps.tip: Use Transference to enter the guest quarters.

steps.t: Retrieve Rell's relic from the Corpus ship on Hydra, Pluto and escape.
Return to Iron Wake and finish the emotion card game.
Trap and kill three of Rell's emotions on Exequias, Deimos with Kinetic Siphon Traps.
steps.tip: Rell's main manifestation cannot be killed, so avoid it.

steps.t: Repeat on Stephano, Uranus.
Repeat on Everest, Earth.
In the Tiwaz temple, kill the Red Veil Fanatics and break the glowing chains with your Operator's Void Beam.

fast: Buy plenty of Kinetic Siphon Traps from Cephalon Simaris and equip them in your Gear before the three capture missions.
Unlock The Quills and Vox Solaris and build an Amp before the last mission; the Mote Amp alone boosts your Operator.
Keep moving as the Operator in the final fight and use Void Sling to knock down Fanatics who block.
Deploy a Specter or two with area-damage weapons to clear the Fanatics quickly.

sum: A short story quest started from your Personal Quarters that sends you to Lua and the Void and sets up The Sacrifice.

steps.t: Touch the violet Lua orb at the end of your Orbiter's Personal Quarters.
steps.tip: You cannot be in a squad.

steps.t: On Lua, touch the orb and follow the purple trail to the broken Reservoir.
Jump down the pit and continue as your Operator.
Walk to the pod at the end of the hall to trigger the final cutscene.

fast: There is no combat; just follow the trail and listen to the dialogue.
Make sure you are solo before touching the orb, or it will not start.

sum: A story quest where you track a mysterious Warframe across the system; it rewards Excalibur Umbra, the Skiajati and Umbra mods.

steps.t: Start The Sacrifice from the Codex and examine the Lotus's helmet in your Personal Quarters.
On Lith, Earth, open the vine door and scan the Skiajati, shawl, helmet and remains in the courtyard.
steps.tip: Codex or Synthesis Scanners work.

steps.t: Solve the two Orokin memory ciphers on Pavlov, Lua and bring back the Vitruvian.
steps.tip: Match the order of the symbol pairs you find nearby.

steps.t: Build Excalibur Umbra in the Foundry and try to equip it.
steps.tip: Needs 10,000 Credits, 1 Orokin Cell, 60 Kuva, 1,200 Nano Spores and 1,600 Alloy Plate; it builds in seconds.

steps.t: Track Umbra on Nuovo, Ceres and use Transference on him.
Pursue Umbra on Triton, Neptune and repeat.
Confront Umbra on Tycho, Lua as your Operator.
steps.tip: Break his shields with Void Beam, stun with Void Sling, then Transference.

steps.t: Return to Lith, Earth and fight the Sentients and Ballas to finish.

fast: Each Umbra fight follows the same pattern: Void Beam his shields, Void Sling to stun, then Transference into him.
Have an Orokin Cell, Nano Spores and Alloy Plate ready so you can build Umbra immediately (the 60 Kuva drops on Pavlov).
If you want the Somachord song, scan the fragment in every mission in order; missing one means replaying the quest.
If you wait too long on the second Lua cipher, Ordis solves it for you.

sum: A story arc of three short mini-quests (Chimera Prologue, Erra and The Maker) that leads into The New War and rewards the Paracesis and Shedu blueprints.

other: Play Chimera Prologue, then Erra, then The Maker from the Codex

steps.t: After The Sacrifice, start Chimera Prologue from the Codex and touch the Lotus's helmet in your Personal Quarters.
Follow The Man in the Wall through the Lua Reservoir and beat the shadow fights.
In the Sentient chamber, Void Sling between hiding spots so Ballas does not see you, then grab the sword.
steps.tip: If his sight bar empties, you fail.

steps.t: Start Erra from the Codex and touch the Lotus's helmet again to watch the vision.
Start The Maker to watch the final cutscene.

fast: Erra and The Maker are mostly cutscenes, so all three parts take only a few minutes each.
In the Chimera Prologue stealth section, move only when Ballas is looking away and wait at each Void Sling point.
Finishing Chimera Prologue also unlocks The Ropalolyst on Jupiter, which drops the Wisp Warframe.
